text:
maria: Quick sync — we need to lock the author lineup for Thu's RFC review (11:00 PT). Four submissions; three reviewers. Can reviewers mark any hard constraints? I'll propose ordering based on review risk + reviewer windows. Links: https://github.com/redwood/rfcs/pull/312 https://github.com/redwood/rfcs/pull/311
chen: I can review but I have a hard stop at 12:30 PT. Prefer earlier slots.
sam: I can take reviewer slot 2. Prefer later in the meeting (no earlier than 11:15).
alex: I'll present RFC-312 but I'd rather be slot 2 so I have time to prep. Also: authors, please post pre-reads by Wed EOD.
katie: I can be timekeeper and call out overruns.
maria: Proposed order (short):
```
1) RFC-311 — 10m presentation + 5m Q
2) RFC-312 — 15m presentation + 10m Q
3) RFC-305 — 10m presentation + 5m Q
4) Quick triage / overflow — 10m
```
If chen needs earlier, we can swap 311/312.
sam: swap is fine for me.
chen: +1 to swap. Small note: if 312 is longer we should reserve the overflow slot.
maria: Good call. I'll add +10 overflow. Also I'll send a Wed 17:00 PT pre-read reminder. @deploy-bot can you post the pre-read ping in #eng tomorrow?
deploy-bot: scheduled reminder posted (will run Tue 17:00 PT)
katie: tiny ask — can we add a 2-min handoff between presenters so we don't overlap slides? :raised_hands:
alex: yes, will hand off to priya cleanly.
maria: Authors — please confirm you'll upload pre-reads (slides + 1 pager) by Wed EOD, otherwise we'll demote to backlog or move you to the overflow slot. @lee @priya
lee: Confirmed — slides uploaded by Tue evening. Link in PR description.
priya: uploading pre-read now, will update PR with TL;DR.
maria: Thanks — final order set: 1) 311 (lee) 2) 312 (alex) 3) 305 (priya) + overflow. Calendar invite updated and agenda pinned. See you Thu — bring any blocking questions into the thread before Wed so reviewers can prep. :pray:
chen: noted. I'll skim PRs tonight and post major Qs in thread.
sam: same, will post any review comments by Wed midday.
maria: Great — closing the loop. If someone needs a swap after Wed morning ping me and we'll do one last reorder.
notes: thread follows Slack style: short messages, @mentions, emoji, code block for agenda. No title per agents.md.
